revelation_claim: The Quran presents itself as revelation from Allah.

manuscript_witnesses.repository: University of Birmingham Cadbury Research Library
manuscript_witnesses.date_statement: Parchment radiocarbon range 568-645 CE at 95.4% probability
manuscript_witnesses.dating_method: Radiocarbon dating of parchment; paleography identifies Hijazi script
manuscript_witnesses.dating_limitations: Radiocarbon dates the parchment material, not the exact moment ink was written.

transmission_summary: Early manuscript evidence places Quranic text in the first century of Islam; textual and reading variants must be audited separately rather than equated with absence of preservation.
historical_assessment: Strong early manuscript evidence; full preservation score remains a composite research question.
